_comment: Immutable base image pin for the Tau targets in this directory. Resolved from the public ghcr.io/primeintellect-ai/prime-rl registry (see resolution_command). Never hand-edit digest/source_commit to a placeholder or 'latest' -- tau/render_image.py refuses to render templates from a malformed pin file.
notes: commit-bbb90a1b4 is the upstream commit this branch's parent sync commit (cddc430f2, 'chore: sync fork to upstream main') was synced from -- the base image's baked /app source tree matches this repo's HEAD tree modulo the tau/ and configs/tau/ additions made on this branch. H200 nodes are linux/amd64 (Standard_ND96isr_H200_v5); the multi-arch index digest resolves the correct platform automatically, amd64_manifest_digest is recorded for manual cross-checking only.
resolution_command: TOKEN=$(curl -s 'https://ghcr.io/token?service=ghcr.io&scope=repository:primeintellect-ai/prime-rl:pull' | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['token'])"); curl -sI -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json' 'https://ghcr.io/v2/primeintellect-ai/prime-rl/manifests/commit-bbb90a1b4' | grep -i docker-content-digest
